broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains stable: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single space, trim. No word-level changes. Tokenizer and pipeline implementations are compatible. Ready for final integration.
tokenizer.js remains correct and unchanged. It calls injected normalize(text) and extracts tokens per spec. Ready for final integration.

pipeline.js remains consistent with round 2 snapshot. processText calls tokenize(text) exactly once, builds frequencies with null prototype to safely handle keys like 'constructor', and returns required structure. text is tokens joined by spaces. No changes needed.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 2: normalize.js unchanged and correct. NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace, trim. No word changes. Peers' tokenizer and pipeline look correct. My responsibility remains normalize.js only. No new issues.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 2: All three files stable. My tokenizer.js unchanged. normalize.js handles non-string by returning unchanged; pipeline.js uses null-prototype object for frequencies. No issues. Continue to monitor for any changes in later rounds; maintain contract strictly.
private_memories.integrator: Round 2: pipeline.js unchanged. Requirements: processText(text) calls injected tokenize(text), returns {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. text = tokens.join(' '). frequencies uses Object.create(null) to handle prototype names. No shadowing. No setup functions. Peers confirmed normalize and tokenizer behavior. Maintain faithful processing.
